summary: Implemented the standard-library REST API for task creation, listing, editing, status movement, deletion, and static UI delivery.

messages.content: API ready: GET/POST /api/tasks; PATCH or PUT /api/tasks/:id; DELETE /api/tasks/:id. Tasks return id, title, status (todo|in_progress|done), created_at. POST requires title and accepts optional status; PATCH accepts title and/or status.

decisions: Used JSON request/response bodies and PATCH for partial task edits/status moves.
Validated titles and status values at the API boundary; used parameterized SQLite statements.
